mainEntity.name: What makes POLISH Media Co. different from generic DTC agencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: POLISH specializes exclusively in beauty, cosmetics, clinical skincare, and luxury fragrance. Unlike generic e-commerce agencies that recycle mass templates, POLISH combines Parisian editorial luxury with clinical scientific validation, 20+ monthly UGC hook variations, and mathematical 60-day replenishment engineering.

mainEntity.name: What minimum revenue is required to partner with POLISH Media Co.?

acceptedAnswer.text: POLISH requires partner brands to generate a verified minimum of $20,000 per month (approx. $240,000 ARR) with proven product-market fit. Our primary acceleration cohort focuses on brands generating between $50,000 and $500,000 per month aiming to break through creative ad fatigue and scale to eight figures.

mainEntity.name: How does the POLISH Creator & UGC Network work?

acceptedAnswer.text: POLISH operates a private, vetted network of on-camera beauty creators. In-house creative directors write direct-response scripts, direct 4K macro texture demonstrations, verify dermatological claims, and deliver 20+ modular video variations per sprint to prevent ad fatigue.

mainEntity.name: What ad platforms and marketing channels does POLISH manage?

acceptedAnswer.text: POLISH manages Meta Ads (Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns), TikTok Ads & TikTok Shop, Google Performance Max (PMax) & high-intent Search, and Klaviyo/SMS/WhatsApp automated replenishment retention loops.

mainEntity.name: How does the proprietary POLISH Whiteboard Studio work?

acceptedAnswer.text: All partner brands receive a private interactive strategy canvas on app.polishmediaco.com. During calibration, founders and agency partners map unit economics, creative hook roadmaps, and sprint deliverables on a GPU-accelerated collaborative whiteboard with read-only executive presentation modes.

mainEntity.name: How fast can campaigns launch after onboarding?

acceptedAnswer.text: The onboarding and calibration sprint takes 10 to 14 business days, covering historical ad audits, custom strategy board deployment, creator casting, and initial asset production. Live campaign scaling commences in Week 3.

mainEntity.name: Does POLISH support international expansion across the US, Europe, and GCC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. POLISH is natively trilingual (English, French, Arabic) with operating hubs in Paris, Dubai (DIFC), and Algiers. The atelier regularly scales brands expanding from the US and Europe into the UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as European beauty houses launching into North America.

mainEntity.name: How can brands apply for a partnership?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brands submit a confidential 2-minute brand brief at polishmediaco.com/apply or schedule a direct 30-minute private diagnostic session at polishmediaco.com/book. Applications are evaluated by a senior partner within 24 hours under strict NDA.
